findings.finding: A single final folder combines old unversioned fraction inputs with remediation_v3 protocol-v2 scores, and all predate October13 correctness/prompt fixes. Fig1/14 TriviaQA78.27 and Fig15fraction.75 TriviaQA67.44 are different protocol results, not conflicting current estimates.
findings.action: Replace validated development quality panels; visibly label otherpanels historical with explicit source manifests.

findings.finding: Negligible accuracy cost/sameaccuracy/accuracyholds claims are asserted without paired NI gate or interval; raw inputs lack sample IDs,predictions,runtime anddataset hashes. Fig8caption hardcodes7→83and−0.16, actual taskmean difference−0.168.
findings.action: Remove superiority/equivalence language; new independent claim requires locked protocol and appropriate data.

findings.finding: Modeled latency/energy sum free-generation requests with unequal outputs. Example GovReport modelsteps: Full3619, adaptedSnap3047,Tieredfair2965. They cannot support pertoken/wholeloop speed or fixedwork energy conclusions.
findings.action: Label summed analytical workloadtraffic and unequalwork; keep measured timing separate.

findings.finding: Token pages label misidentifies per-layer token demotions as pages. Fig6stack includes hysteresis-denied promotions that perform no transfer; demoted count includes avoidedwrites. Sum is policyactions, not migrationtraffic.
findings.action: Name per-layer token events/actions; reserve bytes/pagewrites for explicit transfer accounting.

findings.finding: Leftfraction.75 six-task bars and rightfraction1 five-task STTbudget sweep appear under one efficiencyheading without disclosing different fraction/taskscope. Rightaverages taskratios instead of pooled saved/total.

Fourbars are algebraic configurations from one equalhot config, not4measured runs. BF16GQA128KiB/token constant is correct for statedmodel; excludes packedduplicates,metadata,hostallocator roots and faithfulSnap queryhead expansion.
findings.action: Keep as analytical configuration illustration only; do not present as fullphysical footprint.

findings.finding: Reconstructscomponents with LIVE importedCostModel while total is frozen; labels allremaining billedenergy attention and clamps negative residual tozero. Futurecost changes can silently changeor inflate stack; missingfields default0.
findings.action: Freeze assumptions/hash; call residual otherbilledtraffic; reject negative/missing accounting rather than conceal it.

findings.finding: Legacy errorbars are rowstandarderrors ofrounded sample_scores, not confidenceintervals or document-group paired uncertainty. Dependence exists e.g.current5-row Multifield has4targetgroups.
findings.action: Rescore exact predictions; bootstrap paired targetdocumentgroups, labelconditional uncertainty.

findings.finding: vmax75 clips scores78.27/79.1to samecolor;colorbar omits points×100. Box merely bestpointestimate, not significance.
findings.action: Use0–100points colorrange; box ties across correctmethodset; state no significance.

findings.finding: Hardware/model/contextdecode counts/capacities in captions are hardcoded; global sourcehash equality check doesnot validate them. GenericCLI can mislabel alternateinputs.

limits: Exactpixel reconstruction establishes renderer/input mapping, not scientific validity or sourceepoch equivalence. No newcurrentrun fabricated.
